scope: FFF print-time-and-material estimate for the isolated CM-01 DripTray STL at the reviewed 30 mm R2 geometry (Box 190 × 135 × 30 mm, centred origin), using the committed generic 0.2 mm PLA profile.
evidenceBoundary: Captures FFF print-time-and-material observations (print_time_s, filament_volume_mm3, filament_length_mm, filament_mass_g) for the isolated DripTray STL at the reviewed 30 mm R2 geometry. It is not a cost estimate, pass/fail verdict, requirement evaluation, supplier commitment, whole-machine claim, durability assessment, certification, or fabrication-release claim. Profile parameters are provisional engineering candidates.
limitations: Profile parameters (0.2 mm layer height, 0.4 mm nozzle, PLA, 15% gyroid infill) are provisional engineering candidates sourced from typical FDM desktop-printer guidelines. They have not been validated against a specific printer or material datasheet.
The STL geometry is the simplified Box approximation of the DripTray, not the full assembly with fillets or mounting features.

Print-time accuracy depends on printer firmware and acceleration settings; the estimate is PrusaSlicer's own heuristic and may differ from actual print time by 5-20% (as stated in the not_checked items from the server).
Filament mass is derived from the declared PLA density (1.24 g/cm³) as a reviewed candidate; actual density varies by filament brand and colour.
gcode_sha256 includes a PrusaSlicer build timestamp; identical inputs on different dates produce different G-code hashes. It is an audit reference, not a deterministic attestation.
This estimate covers only the DripTray in isolation; it does not account for whole-machine support material, multi-part nesting, build-plate utilisation, or printer warm-up.
A print-time-and-material estimate does not constitute manufacturing approval, fabrication release, supplier commitment, cost quote, or certification.
The not_checked items reported by mcp-prusaslicer are preserved in the evidence as contractual labels; absence of a warning is never a guarantee.

provenance.note: Profile parameters sourced from typical FDM desktop-printer community guidelines (0.2 mm layer height, 0.4 mm nozzle, PLA, 15% gyroid infill). No printer manufacturer or material supplier has been consulted. Density 1.24 g/cm³ is the generic PLA nominal value.
